## [2.3.0](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/compare/v2.2.0...v2.3.0) (2026-11-21)

### Features

* add x and y axis titles with xAxisTitle and yAxisTitle ([9779407](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/97794072c007cc938249338574b1854fa696a73d))
* hide the x or y axis with hideXAxis and hideYAxis ([5aadd99](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/5aadd993e23f9f7ab092c88fa84be0ff883eaa62))
* let height 100% follow the parent element's height ([de0d102](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/de0d1023f730209ca29e777598e4ef0d5586020d))
* rotate x axis labels with xAxisLabelRotation ([ff04468](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/ff044684a86da872509bf208a91fa02b88339770))
* show pie and donut legends beside the chart with legendPosition ([fa19d81](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/fa19d8114915bc09885d23fb8aee32a4cf1f7d7f))

### Bug Fixes

* call onClick when a column of an axis chart is clicked ([516df7d](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/516df7d462e900836b9fa18bad0816ec695a3d48))
* keep close line values over points from overlapping ([0b64d54](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/0b64d54a92e6308cc2a2d63e1a80bf1283c7c33b))
* scroll the heatmap inside narrow containers instead of overflowing ([1b293e6](https://github.com/frappe/[secure]/commit/1b293e69e6324a3195c604fda4541c9b251ec52d))

detail.readme:
Frappe Charts

**Simple, modern SVG charts for the web, with zero dependencies** [![Test and Release](https://github.com/frappe/charts/actions/workflows/publish.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/frappe/charts/actions/workflows/publish.yml) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/frappe-charts.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/frappe-charts) [![gzipped size](https://deno.bundlejs.com/badge?q=frappe-charts)](https://bundlejs.com/?q=frappe-charts) [Live demos](https://frappe.io/charts)
## Frappe Charts Frappe Charts is a small charting library with a simple API. It started as the sales graph in [ERPNext](https://github.com/frappe/erpnext) and is now used for charts across the [Frappe Framework](https://github.com/frappe/frappe). ### Key Features - **Chart types**: bar, horizontal bar, line, mixed axis, donut, pie, percentage and heatmap. - **Axis charts**: stacked bars, rounded bars, smooth or dashed lines, gaps in lines, region fill, X and Y markers and Y regions. - **Tooltips**: one tooltip per column with every series in it, with your own number format. - **Donut**: a total or your own value in the center, and `onClick` for slices and legend items. - **Live data**: add, remove or replace data points, and the chart animates to the new shape. - **Theming**: colors and lines come from CSS variables such as `--charts-label-color`, so dark mode is a few lines of CSS. - **Export**: save any chart as an SVG file. ## Usage ```bash npm install frappe-charts ``` ```js import { Chart } from 'frappe-charts'; import 'frappe-charts/dist/frappe-charts.min.css'; ``` Or load it in the browser: ```html ``` ```js const chart = new Chart('#chart', { title: 'Sales by channel', type: 'axis-mixed', // or 'bar', 'line', 'donut', 'pie', 'percentage', 'heatmap' height: 250, colors: ['#318ad8', '#30a66d'], data: { labels: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun'], datasets: [ { name: 'Online', chartType: 'bar', values: [42, 48, 39, 55, 61, 58] }, { name: 'Target', chartType: 'line', values: [60, 62, 64, 68, 72, 76] } ], yMarkers: [{ label: 'Goal', value: 70 }] } }); chart.addDataPoint('Jul', [66, 80]); chart.export(); ``` For a horizontal bar chart, use `type: 'bar'` with `barOptions: { horizontal: 1 }`. ## Development Setup * `yarn install` * `yarn watch` - Build on every change * `yarn build` - Build `dist` * `yarn test` - Run the Playwright tests (run `yarn playwright install chromium` once first) * Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org). A merge to `master` runs the tests and publishes a new version to npm. ## Links - [Release notes](https://github.com/frappe/charts/releases), and [older updates](CHANGELOG.md) - [So we decided to create our own charts](https://medium.com/@pratu16x7/so-we-decided-to-create-our-own-charts-a95cb5032c97)
